steps.description: Identify a list of candidate cities worldwide known for excellent air quality suitable for a weekend getaway.
Retrieve current air quality data for each candidate city using the Air Quality API to confirm their air quality status.
Select and recommend a city with excellent confirmed air quality for the weekend getaway.
